messages.content: Help me display the personal information page for a user in a web application, if I have a model object `webModel` and an HTTP request `userRequest` with the parameter 'username' set to 'john_doe'?

function.name: PersonController_personal
function.description: This method retrieves personal information for a logged-in user and adds it to the model before returning the view name for the personal information page. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

model.description: The Model object to which user information attributes are added. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

request.description: The HttpServletRequest object containing the request parameters. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

message.reasoning:
The user wants help to display the personal information page for a user in a web application. They have a model object `webModel` and an HTTP request `userRequest` with the parameter 'username' set to 'john_doe'.

We need to call the function `PersonController_personal` with the appropriate arguments. The function expects a JSON object with keys "model" and "request". The values should be string representations of the Java objects. So we need to pass something like:

{
  "model": "webModel",
  "request": "userRequest"
}

But we also need to mention that the request has the parameter 'username' set to 'john_doe', but the function doesn't need that explicitly; it's part of the request object.

Thus we call the function with those arguments. Then we output the result. The function will return the view name for the personal information page. We need to output that.

So we call the function.
